Subject: Your cross-border insolvency matter - C.P.(IB) No. 2741/2022

Dear Ms. Ghosh,

Thank you for meeting us on 25 July 2022 about your dispute with M/s Lotus Holdings Ltd. As we understand it, the debtor is in insolvency proceedings in two countries.

Our advice is to file the claim with the resolution professional before the deadline. Please collect the loan documents and the statement of the amount due and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
